gpu_tip: ~27GB total at 128K context. With only 16 of Qwen3.8's 64 layers holding a real KV cache, an 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus a 32GB DDR5 kit covers it comfortably — well within reach of a typical gaming rig once llama.cpp splits the layers.
mac_tip: Needs ~27GB — fits a 32GB MacBook Pro (M4 or M5) comfortably.
